vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tao, Franz, the person in their 40s, with ink-stained fingers and the man in his 40s, with a gap-toothed grin met them at the door — 4 put down. Tao, Franz, the person in their 40s, with ink-stained fingers, the man in his 40s, with a gap-toothed grin are hurt.
🛡️ Tao, Franz, Lorenzo, Ursula and Quinn met them at the door — 5 put down. Tao, Franz, Lorenzo, Ursula, Quinn are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Quinn just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tao, Franz, Carlos, Lorenzo and Ursula met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Tao, Franz, Carlos, Lorenzo, Ursula are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Quinn just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Catalina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Rungthip strikes the Elder The Terms of Service.
Catalina strikes the Elder The Terms of Service.
Quinn strikes the Elder The Terms of Service.
The Elder The Terms of Service falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Terms of Service!
📺 You brought down Elder The Terms of Service. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder The Terms of Service.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Miguel — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Miguel chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Miguel Santos, 49 — a dockworker. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Green Thumb, Literally.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
